# Learn More About LabX

What is LabX?

LabX is the premier marketplace for the exchange of [new][90], [used][91], and [refurbished][92] lab
equipment, consumables, and supplies. With millions of buyers and sellers in our network, we
facilitate connections between those seeking to buy laboratory products and those offering them.

keen to explore offerings. Trusted as an industry leader since 1995, LabX continues to set the
standard for excellence in the field.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

strategic growth platforms.

Cole-Parmer SamplePrep Demo Program

Posted: 1 / 9 / 2025

We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

Our dedicated team of experts and our new demo laboratory are here to assist you in determining the
best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

Our demo lab is equipped with fully operational operational homogenizers (bead beaters), cryogenic
mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results
• Virtual sample processing: virtual demonstration of the equipment and sample processing
• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

After completing the sample processing form, please be sure to schedule your sample processing with
a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

[newsImage]

Cole-Parmer SamplePrep Demo Program

Posted: 1 / 9 / 2025

We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

Our dedicated team of experts and our new demo laboratory are here to assist you in determining the
best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

Our demo lab is equipped with fully operational operational homogenizers (bead beaters), cryogenic
mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results
• Virtual sample processing: virtual demonstration of the equipment and sample processing
• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

After completing the sample processing form, please be sure to schedule your sample processing with
a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

### Why Choose an ONH Analyzer for QC in Metals

Quality control decisions are only as reliable as the data behind them. For metals, analyzing alloy
composition alone leaves a critical gap because oxygen, nitrogen, and hydrogen remain hidden within
the material’s structure. Choosing an Oxygen, Nitrogen, and Hydrogen (ONH) analyzer delivers precise
measurement of these interstitial gases, helping manufacturers make informed decisions that protect
product quality throughout production.

Some of the most important elements in an engineering material are also the easiest to overlook.
Oxygen, nitrogen, and hydrogen exist in concentrations too small to see, yet they can determine
whether a component performs reliably or fails prematurely. Measuring these interstitial gases
demands Inert Gas Fusion (IGF) analysis, a benchmark elemental analysis technique for laboratories
working with advanced materials that need to maintain tight control over quality and performance.

diffusible hydrogen, an invisible [element][173] capable of moving through steel long after welding
has finished. Its behavior influences crack formation, structural reliability, and compliance with
recognized welding standards. Knowing how hydrogen enters a weld, migrates through the metal, and is
accurately measured is fundamental to producing long-lasting welding components.

### Why Choose an ONH Analyzer for QC in Metals

Quality control decisions are only as reliable as the data behind them. For metals, analyzing alloy
composition alone leaves a critical gap because oxygen, nitrogen, and hydrogen remain hidden within
the material’s structure. Choosing an Oxygen, Nitrogen, and Hydrogen (ONH) analyzer delivers precise
measurement of these interstitial gases, helping manufacturers make informed decisions that protect
product quality throughout production.

whether a component performs reliably or fails prematurely. Measuring these interstitial gases

## Enabling Industries to be more sustainable and resource-efficient

We help industries become more productive, efficient and sustainable so they can outperform, or as
we say – ‘outrun’.

industries

Building for tomorrow

The $13 trillion global buildings and construction industry faces challenges like high emissions,
material and labor shortages, and low productivity, but ABB's electrification and automation
technologies offer solutions to enhance sustainability, efficiency, and performance.

ABB helps you reduce waste and lower emissions

Scaling data centers

From cloud environments to gigawatt-scale AI, we work side by side with customers and partners to
deliver the world’s most advanced data centers.

One in four data centers run on ABB technology

Feeding a growing world

The global food and beverage industry faces growing demands; to increase output while navigating
supply vulnerabilities, regulations, and resource constraints. In the food and drink sector ABB
provides integrated automation, electrification, and digital technologies that help industries
outperform.

Enabling the food and beverage industry to outperform

Decarbonizing shipping

ABB are paving the way to a zero-emission marine industry, providing greater efficiency and
reliability to shipowners, and preparing vessels to meet the demands of tomorrow.

Driving the evolution of sustainable shipping

Energy transition partner

ABB is making a world of difference by enabling safe, smart and sustainable operations with
integrated solutions that digitalize, automate & electrify the oil and gas industry.

Smart, sustainable operations for oil and gas

The future of energy

Utilities face immense pressure to provide safe, reliable energy while reducing the Levelized Cost
of Electricity. From maintaining grid stability to securing against cyberattacks, power-generation
companies need adaptable, integrated solutions

Shaping tomorrow's power generation landscape

## A global technology leader in electrification and automation

By connecting our engineering and digitalization expertise, we help industries run at high
performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform.

### Electrification

The world needs more power with lower emissions. As a global technology leader in electrical
distribution and management, we bring electrification solutions together to accelerate
decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.

### Automation

ABB's Process Automation business offers a broad range of solutions for process and hybrid
industries, including industry-specific integrated automation, electrification and digital
solutions, control technologies, software and advanced services, as well as measurement & analytics,
and marine offerings.

### Motors and Drives

ABB, global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and
sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy
efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies.

### Power Conversion and Control

ABB power converters and controllers help customers to generate and use energy efficiently. They are
designed for reliable operation even under the most demanding conditions, and for low life cycle
costs.

### Renewable Power

At the heart of the energy transition lies the expansion and reliable integration of solar, wind,
hydro, geothermal and other non-fossil energy sources. Building smarter, more adaptable energy
infrastructure can help leverage the immense potential of renewables.

### Robotics

ABB Robotics is one of the world’s leading robotics suppliers, offering a comprehensive and
integrated portfolio that includes industrial and collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robots
(AMRs), controllers, application solutions, services, and equipment.

## Latest news

## Leading with technology

### The SACE Emax 3

Discover the ultimate evolution in air circuit breaker technology. ABB SACE Emax 3 is engineered to
make electrical distribution systems more adaptive, reliable and secure.

### ABB Genix™ Industrial IoT and AI Suite

Unlock the power of industrial data and AI with ABB Genix IIoT and AI Suite. Bring together domain
expertise with AI and advanced analytics to transform operations, optimize assets and processes,
improve energy efficiency, and accelerate sustainability goals.

### GoFa with Ultra Accuracy

Find out how ABB’s Ultra Accuracy feature makes GoFa the most path-accurate cobot on the market,
offering 10 times greater precision than other cobots, setting a new standard in accuracy. This
superior performance meets the demands of applications where exact positioning is crucial for
maintaining product quality and operational efficiency. 

### Azipod® electric propulsion

From its creation three decades ago to its market leading position in global shipping today, Azipod®
propulsion has revolutionized marine transport

supply vulnerabilities, regulations, and resource constraints. In the food and drink sector ABB
provides integrated automation, electrification, and digital technologies that help industries
outperform.

Enabling the food and beverage industry to outperform

Decarbonizing shipping

ABB are paving the way to a zero-emission marine industry, providing greater efficiency and
reliability to shipowners, and preparing vessels to meet the demands of tomorrow.

Driving the evolution of sustainable shipping

Energy transition partner

ABB is making a world of difference by enabling safe, smart and sustainable operations with
integrated solutions that digitalize, automate & electrify the oil and gas industry.

Smart, sustainable operations for oil and gas

The future of energy

Utilities face immense pressure to provide safe, reliable energy while reducing the Levelized Cost
of Electricity. From maintaining grid stability to securing against cyberattacks, power-generation
companies need adaptable, integrated solutions

Shaping tomorrow's power generation landscape

## A global technology leader in electrification and automation

By connecting our engineering and digitalization expertise, we help industries run at high
performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform.

### Electrification

The world needs more power with lower emissions. As a global technology leader in electrical
distribution and management, we bring electrification solutions together to accelerate
decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.

### Automation

ABB's Process Automation business offers a broad range of solutions for process and hybrid
industries, including industry-specific integrated automation, electrification and digital
solutions, control technologies, software and advanced services, as well as measurement & analytics,
and marine offerings.

### Motors and Drives

ABB, global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and
sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy
efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies.

### Power Conversion and Control

ABB power converters and controllers help customers to generate and use energy efficiently. They are
designed for reliable operation even under the most demanding conditions, and for low life cycle
costs.

### Renewable Power

At the heart of the energy transition lies the expansion and reliable integration of solar, wind,
hydro, geothermal and other non-fossil energy sources. Building smarter, more adaptable energy
infrastructure can help leverage the immense potential of renewables.

### Robotics

ABB Robotics is one of the world’s leading robotics suppliers, offering a comprehensive and
integrated portfolio that includes industrial and collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robots
(AMRs), controllers, application solutions, services, and equipment.

## Latest news

## Leading with technology

### The SACE Emax 3

Discover the ultimate evolution in air circuit breaker technology. ABB SACE Emax 3 is engineered to
make electrical distribution systems more adaptive, reliable and secure.

### ABB Genix™ Industrial IoT and AI Suite

Unlock the power of industrial data and AI with ABB Genix IIoT and AI Suite. Bring together domain
expertise with AI and advanced analytics to transform operations, optimize assets and processes,
improve energy efficiency, and accelerate sustainability goals.

### GoFa with Ultra Accuracy

Find out how ABB’s Ultra Accuracy feature makes GoFa the most path-accurate cobot on the market,
offering 10 times greater precision than other cobots, setting a new standard in accuracy. This
superior performance meets the demands of applications where exact positioning is crucial for
maintaining product quality and operational efficiency. 

### Azipod® electric propulsion

From its creation three decades ago to its market leading position in global shipping today, Azipod®
propulsion has revolutionized marine transport with its unparalleled performance, efficiency,
sustainability and reliability.

### ABB Ability™ Digital Powertrain

The ABB Ability™ Digital Powertrain is a suite of digital solutions and services that enables you to
remotely monitor the health, performance and energy efficiency of powertrains. It combines
connectivity and data analytics with our expertise, helping you to make better decisions for more
efficient, predictable and safe operations.

# Why Choose AEi Systems?

AEi Systems' engineers are the best way for your company to get Worst Case and Reliability analyses
done ASAP and right, the FIRST time!

While many companies perform WCCA and Stress analyses in-house, there are many reasons why our
customers have found AEi Systems to be a better solution.

[Get a Consultation][46]

#### We are Faster
* We have historical Parts Variability databases along with radiation and aging data. We have data
  that is hard to find. In addition, we have our own in-house testing facilities.
* We are the world’s leading expert in SPICE/ADS modeling and have many of the simulation models
  already built for commonly used SPACE parts. AEi Systems is the company that makes models for TI,
  Analog Devices, and many others. We have proprietary agreements and can get data others can’t.
* We have created our own proprietary software to greatly speed up Sensitivity, Signal Integrity,
  and Stress & Derating analyses.
* Analysis is never performed by a single person. It’s always performed by a team of experts with
  experience in key WCCA disciplines (Tolerances, Modeling, Test, Mathematics, Simulation, etc.)

#### We are More Accurate and Rigorous
* Analysis is what we do. It is our core competency and we do it every day. We have been doing WCCA
  for over 30 years and count as our repeat customers top-tier players such as Boeing, Northrop
  Grumman, Lockheed Martin, Raytheon, Honeywell, L3/Harris, Ball Aerospace and many others.
* Our staff has decades of satellite/aerospace and automotive experience in power, linear, RF, and
  digital circuitry.
* Less is missed the first time, saving you iterations and schedule.
* We help FIX the findings and issues we discover.

#### We are Independent
* Let’s face it. Companies, programs, and engineers have biases. Schedule, time, and corporate
  pressures force a biased result. The design suffers.
* As discussed in the Aerospace TOR on WCCA, independence is key to preserving the checks and
  balances that make WCCA valuable.
* Because of our efficiency we can do more in the time and budget allotted. You end up with more
  findings caught and fixed.

Building a successful channel partnership isn’t just about signing an agreement and hoping for the
best. The SaaS companies that consistently scale revenue through partners are the ones that track
the right metrics from day one. In 2026, with partner ecosystems becoming a primary growth lever for
B2B SaaS, knowing how to measure partnership impact is a core competitive advantage.

This guide covers the key metrics every partnership manager needs to track, how to set meaningful
benchmarks, and how to use data to continuously improve partner performance.

[[Why Every Business Needs a Tech Stack for Channel Growth]][41]

##### (2026)][43]

[by channelstrategist][44] [Marketplaces and Distributors][45], [Startup-Specific][46], [Technology
and Tools][47]

Building a channel partner program without the right tech stack is like trying to run a sales team
with no CRM — possible, but painful, slow, and nearly impossible to scale. The tools you use to
recruit partners, enable them, track deals, manage relationships, and measure performance directly
determine how efficiently your channel program can grow.

In 2026, the channel tech stack has matured significantly. There are dedicated tools for every stage
of the partner journey — from initial recruitment through deal registration, co-marketing, and
performance analytics. This guide breaks down the essential technology layers for a scalable channel
program, the leading tools in each category, and how to build a stack that fits your current stage
without over-engineering it.

[Read More][48]

[[Why Your SaaS Business Needs a Channel Sales Strategy for Growth. Channel Partner Strategy for
SaaS Growth Channel partner strategy. Channel growth]][49]
[ 18Jun][50]

##### [Why Your SaaS Needs a Channel Partner Strategy for Growth in 2026][51]

[by channelstrategist][52] [Free Resources and Guides][53], [Marketing Strategies][54], [Partner
Recruitment][55], [Performance Optimization][56], [Strategy Basics][57]

Most SaaS companies hit a wall with direct sales somewhere between $2M and $10M ARR. The pipeline
that got you here — a handful of outbound reps, founder-led deals, and inbound from early SEO —
starts to plateau. Customer acquisition costs climb. The team that worked at 50 customers struggles
to scale to 500. And hiring more sales reps feels like the only lever left.

There’s a better answer: a channel partner strategy. Done right, channel partnerships let you scale
revenue without scaling headcount proportionally. They extend your geographic reach, multiply your
sales capacity, and put your product in front of buyers through trusted relationships your direct
team could never build alone.

This post makes the case for why channel should be part of your SaaS growth strategy in 2026 — and
what it takes to build one that actually delivers.

to scale to 500. And hiring more sales reps feels like the only lever left.

revenue without scaling headcount proportionally. They extend your geographic reach, multiply your
sales capacity, and put your product in front of buyers through trusted relationships your direct
team could never build alone.

  breeding using ionizing radiation to develop novel varieties with desired traits.]][18]
  Vichai Puripunyavanich in the tissue culture lab. His research teams focuses on plant mutation
  breeding using ionizing radiation to develop novel varieties with desired traits.

  ขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน จากระบบนำส่งยานาโนไฮบริดที่ช่วยเสริมฤทธิ์ต้านมะเร็งอย่างทรงประสิทธิภาพ

  สารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย

#### Selamat datang, ようこそ (yokoso), 어서 오세요 (eoseo oseyo)

group of researchers working on nuclear science and its applications. We hope you find the
information here useful. Learn [about us,][22] our [research][23], get to know [our staffs][24] and

  สู่เทคโนโลยีเม็ดบีดกักเก็บสารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุตัวเร่งปฏิกิริยาเชิงแสงที่ช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย
  ซึ่งเทคโนโลยีรังสีคือพลังขับเคลื่อนการสร้างวัสดุนาโนอัจฉริยะเพื่อสุขภาพ อาหาร และสิ่งแวดล้อมอย่างยั่งยืน]][19]
  ดร. ศักดิ์ชัย หลักสี สังเคราะห์วัสดุขั้นสูงด้วยเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์เพื่อนวัตกรรมสีเขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน รวมถึงสารต้านมะเร็ง
  สารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย
* [[ดร. ธนกร แสงทวีสิน มุ่งมั่นพัฒนาการใช้ประโยชน์ผักตบชวาโดยกระบวนการทางรังสี เพื่อการสังเคราะวัสดุคาร์บอนขนาดจิ๋ว
  (carbon dots) ด้วยรังสีแกมมา ที่สามารถนำไปใช้ประโยชน์ที่หลากหลาย อาทิ ฟิล์มกรองแสง ฟิล์มถนอมอาหาร
  แผ่นเยื่อเลือกผ่านเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการนำไฟฟ้าในตัวเก็บประจุ และ อีกมากมาย]][20]
  ดร. ธนกร แสงทวีสิน มุ่งมั่นพัฒนาการใช้ประโยชน์ผักตบชวาโดยกระบวนการทางรังสี เพื่อการสังเคราะวัสดุคาร์บอนขนาดจิ๋ว

#### Selamat datang, ようこそ (yokoso), 어서 오세요 (eoseo oseyo)

Welcome to the homepage of TINT Nuclear Technology Research and Development Center (NTRDC). We are a
group of researchers working on nuclear science and its applications. We hope you find the
information here useful. Learn [about us,][22] our [research][23], get to know [our staffs][24] and
[facilities][25]. We are open for collaboration. Feel free to get in touch with us for details.

We manage the entire sales and redeployment process, handling a single piece of equipment, or
managing your global investment and redeployment program, including plant closures.

EquipNet is the largest online venue for pre-owned manufacturing, packaging, laboratory, test,
electronics, and facility support equipment. Shop 1,000+ equipment categories across 3 sales
channels.

closing a facility consisting of three different buildings. The entire facility needed full
clearance and contained an array of over 400 pieces of R&D equipment.
[Read More][105]

### The Success of Buying & Selling Equipment with EquipNet

EquipNet is constantly working on asset disposition projects with multiple clients across the globe
to help companies buy, sell, and manage their surplus. This case study outlines how EquipNet was
able to help our long-term client buying and selling. 
[Read More][106]

### Cookie Production Line: Colombia

This client originally sought out an auctioneer company to help sell a cookie production line from a
facility in Colombia. When the company was unsuccessful in its efforts, the auctioneer directly
reached out to EquipNet for expert assistance.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."
  
  [Mitch Eger]

* ### Signals incumbent tools miss
  
  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and

  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

## Services

specialized capsule housings, holders, and attachments, custom shielding for transportation,
documentation, and logistic support. Learn more here.

Depleted Neutron Source Return

Any depleted californium-252 neutron source fabricated in our facility can be returned to us for
proper disposal. Customers pay for shipping only - disposal services are free of charge. Learn more

[ [What is Californium?][What is Californium?] ][63]

## What is Californium?

Californium is a soft, metallic radioactive element first synthesized in 1950 at the University of
California at Berkeley’s Radiation Laboratory. One of its isotopes, californium-252 or Cf-252, is a
powerful spontaneous emitter of neutrons. The isotope is widely used in many industries for
initiating a nuclear chain reaction, oil well-logging analysis, material scanning (PGNAA and PINS)
and medical applications.

[Learn More >][64]
[ [Experts in Neutron Sources][Experts in Neutron Sources] ][65]

## Experts in Neutron Sources

Frontier Technology Corporation has over 40 years of experience providing custom neutron sources,
Type-A shipping containers, and neutron shielding solutions to customers in many industries. All of
our sources comply with 10CFR50, Appendix B standards and meet requirements for IAEA Special Form
Certification from the USDOT. We also comply with ODH, Nuclear Regulatory Commission, ISO 2919,
ASTM, and ANSI standards.

# Frontier Technology Corporation

Leading Manufacturer of Californium-252 Neutron Sources
Radioactive Shipping Containers

[Our Products][54] [Contact Us][55]
[

## Sources

Cf-252 neutron sources in standard or custom, single- or double-encapsulated options

View Product ][56] [

## Start up Rods

Complete start up rod assemblies containing Cf-252 and Sb-Be pellets to initiate a nuclear chain
reaction

View Product ][57] [

## Shipping Containers

Type A containers in several sizes for safe domestic or international transport of radioactive
neutron-emitting materials

View Product ][58] [

## Custom Shielding

Custom designed shielding walls manufactured with water-extended polyester (WEP) resin for superior
neutron shielding

View Product ][59] [

## Antimony Pellets

Secondary neutron source that is included in nuclear start up rod assemblies

View Product ][60]

## Services

Frontier offers nuclear solutions for the design and fabrication of state-of-the-art radioactive
products, including sources, PINS, reactor start up rods, custom shielding walls, and Type-A
shipping containers. We are committed to safety, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

[
Custom Turnkey Nuclear Projects

Our experts can provide complete turnkey nuclear solutions including neutron source encapsulation,
specialized capsule housings, holders, and attachments, custom shielding for transportation,
documentation, and logistic support. Learn more here.

][61]
[
Depleted Neutron Source Return

Any depleted californium-252 neutron source fabricated in our facility can be returned to us for
proper disposal. Customers pay for shipping only - disposal services are free of charge. Learn more
here.

][62]
[ [What is Californium?][What is Californium?] ][63]

## What is Californium?

Californium is a soft, metallic radioactive element first synthesized in 1950 at the University of
California at Berkeley’s Radiation Laboratory. One of its isotopes, californium-252 or Cf-252, is a
powerful spontaneous emitter of neutrons. The isotope is widely used in many industries for
initiating a nuclear chain reaction, oil well-logging analysis, material scanning (PGNAA and PINS)
and medical applications.

[Learn More >][64]
[ [Experts in Neutron Sources][Experts in Neutron Sources] ][65]

## Experts in Neutron Sources

Frontier Technology Corporation has over 40 years of experience providing custom neutron sources,
Type-A shipping containers, and neutron shielding solutions to customers in many industries. All of
our sources comply with 10CFR50, Appendix B standards and meet requirements for IAEA Special Form
Certification from the USDOT. We also comply with ODH, Nuclear Regulatory Commission, ISO 2919,
ASTM, and ANSI standards.

[Learn More >][66]

## Who We Are

Because our culture is focused on long-term relationships (with both our clients and our employees),
we are uniquely positioned to solve problems for manufacturers. We are independent and not owned by
an OEM, so we can offer innovative solutions without biases to simply and cost-effectively improve
plant operations. We’ve also built up a wide range of in-house capabilities that fill in the gaps
where other integrators stop short, adding more value and accountability to every project.

###### Our People

At LSI, our core values – service, integrity, and excellence – support our goal to provide the
highest level of benefit in what we do for our customers. Our employees are rewarded for providing
service to the customer first, acting with integrity, and showcasing technical excellence. LSI
employees value hard work and being part of something special.

###### Our Methods

We utilize project execution methodology and metrics tracking to ensure each job’s success. We
always strive for the right application of the proper technology for the purpose required. LSI is
large enough to execute multiple, multi-million dollar projects simultaneously, but small enough to
be responsive to our customers’ needs. We manage each project by focusing on quality, cost, and
schedule. A gap or compromise in any of these three areas will result in projects failing to meet
expectations.

###### Our Reputation

Reputation in the engineering services business is critical to long-term success. LSI knows that we
must excel on every project we do to earn the privilege of being invited back to provide more
services in the future. We depend on repeat business and realize that “we are only as good as our
last project.” We are proud of the fact that our very first customer from 1985 is still an active
and growing customer today.

# Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS)

An open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS
activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.

### Activation Methods[][23]
* Method 1: PowerShell (Recommended)
* Method 2: Traditional (Offline)

**This method is the most convenient and works on Windows 8.1, 10, and 11.**
1. Click the **Start Menu**, type `PowerShell`, and open it.
2. Copy and paste the code below and press **Enter.**

`
irm https://get.activated.win | iex
`
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

**Having trouble? (Blocked by ISP or Old Windows)**

**If the command is blocked:**
Some ISPs block the URL. Use this command to bypass DNS blocks (Windows 10/11 only):

`
iex (curl.exe -s --doh-url https://1.1.1.1/dns-query https://get.activated.win | Out-String)
`

**If you receive a TLS/SSL Error (Older Windows):**
If you are on an old build of Windows 8.1 or 10, run this command *before* the main command:

`
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
`

**Still not working?** You need to use a VPN like [Cloudflare WARP][24] or follow method 2 instead.

**Use this method if you prefer downloading a file or cannot use the PowerShell method.**
1. Download the script:
   * [**MAS_AIO.cmd**][25] (Direct script)
   * [**MAS_AIO.zip**][26] (If the direct script is blocked by your browser)
2. Run the `MAS_AIO.cmd` file.
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

tip
* Some ISPs/DNS providers block access to our domains. You can bypass this by enabling
  [DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH)][27] in your browser.
* **Having trouble?** Connect with us [here][28].
note
* The `irm` command in PowerShell downloads a script from a specified URL, and the `iex` command
  executes it.
* Always double-check the URL before executing the command and verify the source is trustworthy when
  manually downloading files.
* Be cautious of third parties spreading malware disguised as MAS by altering the URL in the
  PowerShell command.

## MAS Latest Release[][29]

Latest Release: v3.12 (4-Jul-2026)
[GitHub][30] / [Azure DevOps][31] / [Self-hosted Git][32]

## Features[][33]
* **HWID (Digital License):** Permanently activate Windows.
* **Ohook:** Permanently activate Office.
* **TSforge:** Permanently activate Windows, ESU, and Office.
* **Online KMS:** Activate Windows/Office for 180 days (Lifetime with renewal task).
* Advanced activation troubleshooting.
* $OEM$ folders for pre-activation.
* Change Windows edition.
* Change Office edition.
* Check Windows/Office activation status.
* Available in All-In-One and separate file versions.
* Fully open source and based on batch scripts.
* Fewer antivirus detections.

## Activations Summary[][34]

Type      │Product        │                          │                                              
──────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
HWID      │Windows 10-11  │Permanent                 │Yes                                           
──────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
Ohook     │Office         │Permanent                 │No                                            
──────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
TSforge   │Windows / ESU /│Permanent                 │Only needed for StaticCID method (used on     
          │Office         │                          │build 26100 and above)                        
──────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
Online KMS│Windows /      │180 Days (Lifetime with   │Yes                                           
          │Office         │renewal task)             │                                              
──────────┴───────────────┴──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────

For more details, see the respective pages in the documentation and the [comparison chart][35].
To activate unsupported products such as **Office on Mac**, see [here][36].

# Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS)

An open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS
activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.

### Activation Methods[][23]
* Method 1: PowerShell (Recommended)
* Method 2: Traditional (Offline)

**This method is the most convenient and works on Windows 8.1, 10, and 11.**
1. Click the **Start Menu**, type `PowerShell`, and open it.
2. Copy and paste the code below and press **Enter.**

`
irm https://get.activated.win | iex
`
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

**Having trouble? (Blocked by ISP or Old Windows)**

**If the command is blocked:**
Some ISPs block the URL. Use this command to bypass DNS blocks (Windows 10/11 only):

`
iex (curl.exe -s --doh-url https://1.1.1.1/dns-query https://get.activated.win | Out-String)
`

**If you receive a TLS/SSL Error (Older Windows):**
If you are on an old build of Windows 8.1 or 10, run this command *before* the main command:

`
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
`

**Still not working?** You need to use a VPN like [Cloudflare WARP][24] or follow method 2 instead.

**Use this method if you prefer downloading a file or cannot use the PowerShell method.**
1. Download the script:
   * [**MAS_AIO.cmd**][25] (Direct script)
   * [**MAS_AIO.zip**][26] (If the direct script is blocked by your browser)
2. Run the `MAS_AIO.cmd` file.
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

tip
* Some ISPs/DNS providers block access to our domains. You can bypass this by enabling
  [DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH)][27] in your browser.
* **Having trouble?** Connect with us [here][28].
note
* The `irm` command in PowerShell downloads a script from a specified URL, and the `iex` command
  executes it.
* Always double-check the URL before executing the command and verify the source is trustworthy when
  manually downloading files.
* Be cautious of third parties spreading malware disguised as MAS by altering the URL in the
  PowerShell command.

## MAS Latest Release[][29]

Latest Release: v3.12 (4-Jul-2026)
[GitHub][30] / [Azure DevOps][31] / [Self-hosted Git][32]

## Features[][33]
* **HWID (Digital License):** Permanently activate Windows.
* **Ohook:** Permanently activate Office.
* **TSforge:** Permanently activate Windows, ESU, and Office.
* **Online KMS:** Activate Windows/Office for 180 days (Lifetime with renewal task).
* Advanced activation troubleshooting.
* $OEM$ folders for pre-activation.
* Change Windows edition.
* Change Office edition.
* Check Windows/Office activation status.
* Available in All-In-One and separate file versions.
* Fully open source and based on batch scripts.
* Fewer antivirus detections.

## Frequently Asked Questions
## About Laboratory Testing Services
* What is a commercial testing laboratory, and what do testing labs actually do?
  
  Commercial testing laboratories provide third-party analytical testing to businesses,
  organizations, and agencies that need accurate, independent results. Testing can be related to
  things such as water safety, food quality, life sciences research, or staying compliant with a
  regulatory requirement. [Our team][71] at Microbac Laboratories has been doing this work for over
  50 years, and we bring that experience to every project we take on.
* What industries does Microbac Laboratories serve?
  
  We work across a wide range of industries — environmental, food and beverage, life sciences,
  [energy][72], [manufacturing][73], [municipal water systems][74], and [federal government][75],
  among others. With 30+ lab locations nationwide, we’re equipped to support both routine testing
  programs and more complex, specialized needs regardless of your industry or project size.
* What types of testing does Microbac Laboratories offer?
  
  We cover [environmental][76], [food][77], and [life sciences testing][78] — so whether you’re
  dealing with a compliance requirement, a quality issue, or something that needs a closer look, our
  team at Microbac Laboratories can likely help. We’re also flexible on how we work with you, and we
  can shape our services around what your project actually needs rather than fitting you into a box.
* How do I get started submitting a sample?
  
  [Request testing here][79]. From there, our staff will walk you through sample collection
  requirements, chain of custody, and the turnaround expectations. We always want to make the
  process as straightforward as possible so you’re not spending more time on logistics than you need
  to.
* What accreditations does Microbac Laboratories hold?
  
  We’re one of the **top five largest analytical laboratory networks in the U.S.**, and our
  accreditations reflect that. Our team maintains rigorous quality standards so you can stand behind
  every result — whether it’s for internal use, a regulatory submission, or public health
  protection. Specific accreditations vary by location and discipline, so we’d recommend connecting
  with your local lab for details.

## Frequently Asked Questions
## About Laboratory Testing Services
* What is a commercial testing laboratory, and what do testing labs actually do?
  
  Commercial testing laboratories provide third-party analytical testing to businesses,
  organizations, and agencies that need accurate, independent results. Testing can be related to
  things such as water safety, food quality, life sciences research, or staying compliant with a
  regulatory requirement. [Our team][71] at Microbac Laboratories has been doing this work for over
  50 years, and we bring that experience to every project we take on.
* What industries does Microbac Laboratories serve?
  
  We work across a wide range of industries — environmental, food and beverage, life sciences,
  [energy][72], [manufacturing][73], [municipal water systems][74], and [federal government][75],
  among others. With 30+ lab locations nationwide, we’re equipped to support both routine testing
  programs and more complex, specialized needs regardless of your industry or project size.
* What types of testing does Microbac Laboratories offer?
  
  We cover [environmental][76], [food][77], and [life sciences testing][78] — so whether you’re
  dealing with a compliance requirement, a quality issue, or something that needs a closer look, our
  team at Microbac Laboratories can likely help. We’re also flexible on how we work with you, and we
  can shape our services around what your project actually needs rather than fitting you into a box.
* How do I get started submitting a sample?
  
  [Request testing here][79]. From there, our staff will walk you through sample collection
  requirements, chain of custody, and the turnaround expectations. We always want to make the
  process as straightforward as possible so you’re not spending more time on logistics than you need
  to.
* What accreditations does Microbac Laboratories hold?
  
  We’re one of the **top five largest analytical laboratory networks in the U.S.**, and our
  accreditations reflect that. Our team maintains rigorous quality standards so you can stand behind
  every result — whether it’s for internal use, a regulatory submission, or public health
  protection. Specific accreditations vary by location and discipline, so we’d recommend connecting
  with your local lab for details.

### [Neutron Activation Analysis – Main Advancements in Trace Element Detection in Food Samples][51]

Inga Zinicovscaia, Dmitrii Grozdov

As a high-priority issue for sustainable global development, food security requires attention to
both the quantity and quality of food. Trace elements pose a complex challenge for food security in
this context; they can be beneficial as essential micronutrients or harmful as toxic contaminants
that compromise food safety and public health. Consequently, advanced analytical tools, particularly
elemental analysis, are employed to verify food quality, authenticity, and traceability. Since its
first application in 1936 neutron activation analysis has proven to be a powerful analytical
technique for determining the elemental composition of a wide variety of samples. The method's
widespread adoption is due to its numerous benefits, including its multi-element character,
non-destructive nature, high sensitivity and precision, ultra-low detection limits, and simple
sample preparation. These advantages have led to its use in critical fields such as food safety,
agriculture, and environmental monitoring. The paper provides an introduction to the biological role
and toxicity of trace elements, discusses the fundamental principles, strengths, and limitations of
neutron activation analysis, and presents an overview of NAA applications in food analysis, along
with a summary of key findings.

### [Pulsed fast reactors][54]

V. L. Aksenov, А. Е. Verkhoglyadov, M. M. Podlesnyy, E. P. Shabalin

In 1960, the world’s first pulsed fast nuclear reactor (IBR) was created at JINR. The
second-generation IBR-2 reactor has been in operation since 1984. An analysis of the distinctive
characteristics of the IBR-type reactors is presented, the main one of which is related to the
instabilities of power fluctuations. A description of the conceptual design of a third-generation
NEPTUN reactor is proposed, which solves the problem of instabilities and opens up new possibilities
for neutron beam research.

[cover]
26.06.2026
DOI: [ 10.54546/NaturalSciRev.100705 ][55]

### [Classification of muon tracks from charmonium decays and pion tracks in the model of the SPD
### detector using neural networks][56]

Alisa R. Didenko, Ivan V. Yeletskikh, Andrei O. Gridin

The Machine Learning (ML) approaches were applied to particle identification in the simulation of
the Spin Physics Detector (SPD) at the NICA Collider. The results of the identification of muon
tracks originating from charmonia decays and pion tracks in the intermediate momenta region (1.5–2.5
GeV/c) are presented. The obtained classifier accuracy is 77% while preserving 99% of muons and
rejecting 48% of pions. The efficiency of developed binary classifier is demonstrated through
background suppression in *J/ψ* → *µµ* decays.

[cover]
25.06.2026
DOI: [ 10.54546/NaturalSciRev.100704 ][57]

### [Temperature-dependent conformational changes of amyloid-β42 in DPPC bilayers][58]

Khlood A. A. Abdeljawaad, Yersultan Arynbek , Kahramon Mamatkulov, Huy Le Duc, Grigory Arzumanyan

The conformational behavior of the amyloid-*β*42 (A*β*42) peptide is strongly influenced by the
physical state of its surrounding lipid environment. The effect of temperature on the A*β*42
structure within dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine (DPPC) bilayers was investigated using circular
dichroism (CD), Raman spectroscopy, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The study examined two
thermal phases: room temperature (RT =∼ (25±2)◦C), corresponding to the gel phase of DPPC, and
(48±2)◦C, representing the fluid phase above the lipid transition *temperature*. The CD spectroscopy
measurements indicated a clear temperature-dependent structural transition of the peptide. At RT,
A*β*42 exhibited a conformation enriched in *β* structures, while at (48±2)◦C, the spectra revealed
a notable increase in *α*-helical content, reflecting enhanced backbone organization under
fluid-phase conditions. Raman spectral analysis supported this trend by demonstrating an increased
contribution of *α*-helical components accompanied by a reduction in *β*-strand features upon
heating. Minor variations in lipid vibrational markers further suggested greater acyl-chain
flexibility and bilayer fluidity in the high-temperature state. Furthermore, MD simulations revealed
enhanced α-helical content and deeper peptide insertion within the disordered bilayer compared with
the ordered gel phase. The findings from experimental and computational investigations demonstrate
that membrane fluidization above the DPPC phase transition favors α-helical stabilization of A*β*42,
emphasizing temperature as a key parameter governing peptide–lipid conformational equilibria. The
results obtained provide a fundamental framework for understanding how thermal conditions modulate
amyloid-membrane interactions, which is essential for elucidating the early molecular events
associated with amyloid-related pathologies.

characteristics of the IBR-type reactors is presented, the main one of which is related to the
instabilities of power fluctuations. A description of the conceptual design of a third-generation
NEPTUN reactor is proposed, which solves the problem of instabilities and opens up new possibilities
for neutron beam research.

[cover]
26.06.2026
DOI: [ 10.54546/NaturalSciRev.100705 ][55]

### [Classification of muon tracks from charmonium decays and pion tracks in the model of the SPD
### detector using neural networks][56]

Alisa R. Didenko, Ivan V. Yeletskikh, Andrei O. Gridin

The Machine Learning (ML) approaches were applied to particle identification in the simulation of
the Spin Physics Detector (SPD) at the NICA Collider. The results of the identification of muon
tracks originating from charmonia decays and pion tracks in the intermediate momenta region (1.5–2.5
GeV/c) are presented. The obtained classifier accuracy is 77% while preserving 99% of muons and
rejecting 48% of pions. The efficiency of developed binary classifier is demonstrated through
background suppression in *J/ψ* → *µµ* decays.

[cover]
25.06.2026
DOI: [ 10.54546/NaturalSciRev.100704 ][57]

### [Temperature-dependent conformational changes of amyloid-β42 in DPPC bilayers][58]

Khlood A. A. Abdeljawaad, Yersultan Arynbek , Kahramon Mamatkulov, Huy Le Duc, Grigory Arzumanyan

The conformational behavior of the amyloid-*β*42 (A*β*42) peptide is strongly influenced by the
physical state of its surrounding lipid environment. The effect of temperature on the A*β*42
structure within dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine (DPPC) bilayers was investigated using circular
dichroism (CD), Raman spectroscopy, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The study examined two
thermal phases: room temperature (RT =∼ (25±2)◦C), corresponding to the gel phase of DPPC, and
(48±2)◦C, representing the fluid phase above the lipid transition *temperature*. The CD spectroscopy
measurements indicated a clear temperature-dependent structural transition of the peptide. At RT,
A*β*42 exhibited a conformation enriched in *β* structures, while at (48±2)◦C, the spectra revealed
a notable increase in *α*-helical content, reflecting enhanced backbone organization under
fluid-phase conditions. Raman spectral analysis supported this trend by demonstrating an increased
contribution of *α*-helical components accompanied by a reduction in *β*-strand features upon
heating. Minor variations in lipid vibrational markers further suggested greater acyl-chain
flexibility and bilayer fluidity in the high-temperature state. Furthermore, MD simulations revealed
enhanced α-helical content and deeper peptide insertion within the disordered bilayer compared with
the ordered gel phase. The findings from experimental and computational investigations demonstrate
that membrane fluidization above the DPPC phase transition favors α-helical stabilization of A*β*42,
emphasizing temperature as a key parameter governing peptide–lipid conformational equilibria. The
results obtained provide a fundamental framework for understanding how thermal conditions modulate
amyloid-membrane interactions, which is essential for elucidating the early molecular events
associated with amyloid-related pathologies.

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

**APPLICATIONS**

**Research**

Optosky instruments are crucial in scientific research, enabling non-invasive, precise analysis of
biomolecules and tissues. Their spectrometers enhance efficiency in molecular biology and medical
diagnostics, driving innovations in health sciences.




[[spectrometer optical instrument]][10]

**Security**

Optosky's portable spectrometers provide fast, reliable detection of hazardous materials,
explosives, and illegal substances, helping law enforcement and security personnel protect
communities and respond to threats.









[[spectrometer oem supprot]][11]

**Industry**

Optosky’s spectroscopy systems are crucial in industrial analysis, providing real-time monitoring to
ensure material and product quality, boost efficiency, reduce waste, and improve process control.







[[spectrometer oem applications]][12]

**Bioscience**

Optosky's spectrometers enable precise, non-invasive analysis of biomolecules and tissues, advancing
molecular biology, biotechnology, and medical diagnostics for health science breakthroughs.





[[spectrometer oem solution]][13]

**Environment**

Optosky's spectroscopy technologies play a vital role in environmental science by detecting
pollutants in air, water, and soil, enabling timely interventions and supporting global
environmental sustainability efforts.

[[spectrometer oem supprot]][14]

**Food Safety**

Food Safety is a global concern, and Optosky's solutions ensure food quality and safety. Using
non-destructive spectral analysis, their instruments detect contaminants, adulterants, and nutrient
levels in real-time, protecting consumer health and ensuring compliance.





[[spectrometer oem applications]][15]

**Minerals**

Optosky’s advanced spectrometers accurately identify gemstones and minerals, revealing composition,
authenticity, and quality. Raman spectroscopy effectively distinguishes natural from synthetic gems,
aiding in value assessment and authentication.







[[spectrometer oem solution]][16]

**Semiconductor **

Raman spectroscopy is widely used in semiconductors to study material properties. For example,
graphene has a distinct Raman peak linked to its chemical structure and composition.




[[spectrometer oem solution]][17]

Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices

* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not

phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

## **Sanchar Saathi App – Download and Features**

The Sanchar Saathi App, available on the Google Play Store, provides all major features of the
portal in one mobile application.

### **How to Download the Sanchar Saathi App**
1. Open the Play Store on your Android phone
2. Search for “[**Sanchar Saathi App**][29]”
3. Tap Install and open the app after downloading
4. Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP

The app offers a simple dashboard that lets users access CEIR, TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi, and KYM
features in one place. It is expected to come pre-installed on all new smartphones as per DoT’s 2025
guidelines.

**Note**: The Government of India has made it mandatory for all new smartphones to come with the
[**Sanchar Saathi app**][30] pre-installed, ensuring users stay protected from SIM misuse and mobile
fraud.

### **Key Features of the Sanchar Saathi App**
* Check all mobile numbers linked to your identity
* Verify if a mobile device is genuine using its IMEI number
* Block or unblock lost and recovered phones
* Report fraud calls, scam messages, or fake customer-care numbers
* View official and trusted helpline numbers of banks and telecom operators

The app also integrates with a new DoT service called Chakshu, which allows users to report
suspicious communication such as phishing messages or fake financial service calls.

## **TAFCOP Consumer Portal – Benefits for Users**

The TAFCOP Consumer Portal helps users monitor and secure their telecom accounts. Some key benefits
include:
* Easy access to all active SIMs under your name
* Option to report and block unknown or inactive numbers
* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

The TAFCOP mobile number check feature ensures no one misuses your identity to obtain extra SIM
cards without consent.

## **Sanchar Saathi and Data Privacy Concerns**

While the Sanchar Saathi App strengthens user safety, there are also concerns about data privacy and
protection. As the platform stores IMEI numbers, mobile identities, and telecom data, questions
arise about how securely this information is managed.

**Some experts believe the app should include:**
* Clear guidelines on how long user data is stored
* Stronger encryption to prevent unauthorized access
* Transparent policies about who can view or use stored data
* Strict penalties for misuse of personal information

To maintain user trust, the DoT is expected to release a comprehensive privacy framework that
defines how Sanchar Saathi and TAFCOP data will be handled.

## **Impact of Sanchar Saathi Portal on Telecom Security**

The Sanchar Saathi TAFCOP initiative has significantly improved transparency in the telecom sector.
It allows citizens to directly control and verify their digital identity, reducing the risk of SIM
cloning, fake activations, and identity theft.

Telecom operators are also required to update their systems regularly to align with Sanchar Saathi’s
security standards. This results in better tracking of user activity, fewer spam calls, and a more
accountable network.

## **Way Forward**

Going forward, the Sanchar Saathi Portal and App can be made even more effective by:
* Expanding awareness about its features through digital literacy campaigns
* Encouraging telecom companies and phone makers to integrate it deeply into devices
* Ensuring better coordination with law enforcement for stolen phone recovery
* Introducing multilingual support for rural and regional users

With consistent updates, the Sanchar Saathi and TAFCOP Sancharsaathi platforms can play a vital role
in achieving a safer digital ecosystem in India.

> **Note:** Beware of apps playing on mobile the **[Jalwa][31]** & **[Tiranga][32]**. Always play
> responsibly and be aware of potential risks before engaging in online gaming platforms.

## **FAQs on Sanchar Saathi Portal**

#### Q1. What is the Sanchar Saathi Portal?

It is a DoT initiative that allows users to verify SIM cards, block lost phones, and check IMEI
authenticity online.

#### Q2. How can I check SIM cards linked to my Aadhaar?

Visit tafcop.sancharsaathi.gov.in, enter your mobile number, verify OTP, and view all linked
numbers.

#### Q3. What is the role of CEIR in Sanchar Saathi?

The Central Equipment Identity Register helps block or trace stolen mobile devices using their IMEI
numbers.

#### Q4. Can I download the Sanchar Saathi App?

Yes, it is available on Google Play Store and soon on Apple App Store.

#### Q5. Is Sanchar Saathi safe to use?

Yes, it is developed by the Department of Telecommunications, though users should stay aware of
privacy settings and permissions.

needs analyses; planning and scheduling the installation of new or modified hardware/software;

documentation, and access to systems and equipment; administering passwords; monitoring the
performance, capacity, availability, serviceability, and recoverability of installed systems.

## BNSS - IoT & Robotics Training

# WOKWI SIMULATION PROJECTS

An online simulation platform for designing, testing, and debugging electronics projects with
microcontrollers like Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico—no physical hardware required.

[Explore Wokwi Official Site][3]

## Core Features

Wokwi provides a powerful, user-friendly environment that enables users to design and debug embedded
systems with ease.

[Real-time Simulation Icon]

### Real-time Simulation

Observe system behavior with instant visual feedback from your circuit.

[Code Editor Icon]

### Integrated Code Editor

Write, test, and debug your firmware directly in the browser.

[Component Library Icon]

### Vast Component Library

Access a huge library of sensors, displays, and other modules.

[Sharing Icon]

### Collaboration & Sharing

Distribute and demonstrate projects easily via simple shareable links.

## How to Use Wokwi Simulation
1. **Connnect the Modules**
   * Follow the schematic diagram provided.
   * Use the left side (sketch.ino) to write your Arduino code.
2. ** Add Components**
   * Click the “+” button on the right side of the screen.
   * Select components such as LEDs, resistors, push buttons, sensors, etc.
   * Drag and drop the selected components into the virtual workspace.
3. **Wire the Components**
   * Click on a component's pin and drag a wire to the appropriate Arduino pin.
   * Ensure all connections match the schematic for correct functionality.
4. ** Run the Simulation**
   * Click the green "Play" button at the top to start the simulation.
   * Observe your circuit in action.
   * Click “Pause” to stop the simulation when needed.
5. ** Save or Share Your Project**
   * Click the Save icon to store your project.

## IoT Simulation Projects

Explore a variety of hands-on projects you can build and test right here. Click on any project to
get started with a step-by-step guide.

[Automatic water level controller]

### Automatic Water Level Controller

[Do it Yourself (DIY) →][4]
[Digital clock with temperature & humidity sensor]

An online simulation platform for designing, testing, and debugging electronics projects with

## Core Features

Wokwi provides a powerful, user-friendly environment that enables users to design and debug embedded
systems with ease.

[Real-time Simulation Icon]

### Real-time Simulation

Observe system behavior with instant visual feedback from your circuit.

[Code Editor Icon]

### Integrated Code Editor

Write, test, and debug your firmware directly in the browser.

[Component Library Icon]

### Vast Component Library

Access a huge library of sensors, displays, and other modules.

[Sharing Icon]

### Collaboration & Sharing

Distribute and demonstrate projects easily via simple shareable links.

## How to Use Wokwi Simulation
1. **Connnect the Modules**
   * Follow the schematic diagram provided.
   * Use the left side (sketch.ino) to write your Arduino code.
2. ** Add Components**
   * Click the “+” button on the right side of the screen.
   * Select components such as LEDs, resistors, push buttons, sensors, etc.
   * Drag and drop the selected components into the virtual workspace.
3. **Wire the Components**
   * Click on a component's pin and drag a wire to the appropriate Arduino pin.
   * Ensure all connections match the schematic for correct functionality.
4. ** Run the Simulation**
   * Click the green "Play" button at the top to start the simulation.

организацией [контейнерных перевозок][59].

деятельностью.

## Изучили все тонкости и нюансы доставки грузов из Китая в Россию

**Мы точно знаем, как добиться от фабрики необходимого качества, как правильно перевести деньги за
товар и доставить его в Россию. Даже если речь идет о санкционных категориях.**

#### Как вы переводите деньги в Китай?
* Для начала мы объясняем фабрикам на китайском языке, как принять деньги из России в условиях
  санкций 
* Затем мы делаем юридически корректные документы для быстрого прохождения валютного контроля и
  последующей таможенной очистки в РФ. Готовим договор с поставщиком до запуска проекта, чтобы
  сократить время исполнения платежа 
* После этого отправляем деньги через наших агентов, за которых мы ручаемся
* А еще мы организуем закупку у фабрик без экспортной лицензии с помощью наших экспортных агентов в
  Китае, а также у фабрик, не готовых показывать связь с РФ

#### Как вы работаете с поставщиком?
* Мы организуем КОНТРАКТНОЕ производство. Т.е. товар на фабрике производится под вас. Это может быть
  как типовой товар, так и кастомизированный
* Следовательно, мы можем договориться и о кастомизации: от простой в виде логотипа до сложной в
  виде создания нового продукта
* Можем взять на себя весь процесс поиска необходимой продукции в Китае по вашему ТЗ и предоставляем
  выбор из нескольких надежных поставщиков, а также привозим образцы понравившихся товаров, чтобы вы
  лично проверили соответствие желаемому качеству, внешнему виду и функциональности
* Выйдем на связь с поставщиком на китайском языке, когда у вас есть только ссылка на их сайт или
  название фабрики

#### Как вы добиваетесь от поставщика нужного качества?
* Мы проводим переговоры с китайскими поставщиками по условиям контракта. Прописываем в договоре
  санкции если поставщик нарушил сроки производства и возмещение денежных средств в случае брака
* Организуем конфколлы на китайском языке, для верного понимания фабрикой что нужно произвести

#### У нас сложный технический продукт. Вы за такое беретесь?
* Да. Для начала мы делаем перевод на китайский сложной технической документации
* Организуем выезд нашего человека в Китае на контроль качества продукции (убеждаемся в том, что
  фабрика действительно произвела нужный продукт). Можем организовать инспекцию в режиме онлайн с
  вашим присутствием
* Проводим лабораторные исследования образцов товаров
* Организуем визит китайских специалистов в РФ для пусконаладочных работ

#### Какие гарантии?
* Мы фиксируем цену на весь проект, включая транспорт и таможню перед стартом проекта. Цена
  окончательная, без скрытых платежей. Исключение - изменение веса и габаритов груза фабрикой после
  окончания производства
* Мы работаем по агентскому договору. Вы видите на что уходят ваши деньги
* А до заключения договора мы составим прозрачное КП, где будут расписаны все статьи затрат
* Работаем полностью в белую. Вы легко можете проверить наши юр. лица: ООО "Стандард" и ООО
  "Трейдест" на любых порталах анализа контрагентов
* И, главное, мы работаем на рынке с 2012 года. Мы пережили присоединение Крыма, пандемию Ковида,
  конфликт на Украине и пакеты санкций. Отзывы о нас легко ищутся. Все эти годы мы работаем достойно

## Изучили все тонкости и нюансы доставки грузов из Китая в Россию

**Мы точно знаем, как добиться от фабрики необходимого качества, как правильно перевести деньги за
товар и доставить его в Россию. Даже если речь идет о санкционных категориях.**

#### Как вы переводите деньги в Китай?
* Для начала мы объясняем фабрикам на китайском языке, как принять деньги из России в условиях
  санкций 
* Затем мы делаем юридически корректные документы для быстрого прохождения валютного контроля и
  последующей таможенной очистки в РФ. Готовим договор с поставщиком до запуска проекта, чтобы
  сократить время исполнения платежа 
* После этого отправляем деньги через наших агентов, за которых мы ручаемся
* А еще мы организуем закупку у фабрик без экспортной лицензии с помощью наших экспортных агентов в
  Китае, а также у фабрик, не готовых показывать связь с РФ

#### Как вы работаете с поставщиком?
* Мы организуем КОНТРАКТНОЕ производство. Т.е. товар на фабрике производится под вас. Это может быть
  как типовой товар, так и кастомизированный
* Следовательно, мы можем договориться и о кастомизации: от простой в виде логотипа до сложной в
  виде создания нового продукта
* Можем взять на себя весь процесс поиска необходимой продукции в Китае по вашему ТЗ и предоставляем
  выбор из нескольких надежных поставщиков, а также привозим образцы понравившихся товаров, чтобы вы
  лично проверили соответствие желаемому качеству, внешнему виду и функциональности
* Выйдем на связь с поставщиком на китайском языке, когда у вас есть только ссылка на их сайт или
  название фабрики

#### Как вы добиваетесь от поставщика нужного качества?
* Мы проводим переговоры с китайскими поставщиками по условиям контракта. Прописываем в договоре
  санкции если поставщик нарушил сроки производства и возмещение денежных средств в случае брака
* Организуем конфколлы на китайском языке, для верного понимания фабрикой что нужно произвести

#### У нас сложный технический продукт. Вы за такое беретесь?
* Да. Для начала мы делаем перевод на китайский сложной технической документации
* Организуем выезд нашего человека в Китае на контроль качества продукции (убеждаемся в том, что
  фабрика действительно произвела нужный продукт). Можем организовать инспекцию в режиме онлайн с
  вашим присутствием
* Проводим лабораторные исследования образцов товаров
* Организуем визит китайских специалистов в РФ для пусконаладочных работ

#### Какие гарантии?
* Мы фиксируем цену на весь проект, включая транспорт и таможню перед стартом проекта. Цена
  окончательная, без скрытых платежей. Исключение - изменение веса и габаритов груза фабрикой после
  окончания производства
* Мы работаем по агентскому договору. Вы видите на что уходят ваши деньги
* А до заключения договора мы составим прозрачное КП, где будут расписаны все статьи затрат
* Работаем полностью в белую. Вы легко можете проверить наши юр. лица: ООО "Стандард" и ООО
  "Трейдест" на любых порталах анализа контрагентов
* И, главное, мы работаем на рынке с 2012 года. Мы пережили присоединение Крыма, пандемию Ковида,
  конфликт на Украине и пакеты санкций. Отзывы о нас легко ищутся. Все эти годы мы работаем достойно

### [ World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews: an International Journal ][23]

## WJARR is an International ISSN Approved Journal

**World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews (WJARR)** is an international journal dedicated to
the publication of high-quality research and review articles. WJARR is an ISSN approved journal with
e-ISSN **2581-9615**. The journal is an **open access** publication issued with a monthly frequency
(12 issues per year).

World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews is a **peer-reviewed and highly indexed journal**
ensuring quality scholarly publication. The journal offers authors an affordable publication process
with very low publication fees. WJARR maintains a high impact factor (Impact factor 8.2) and is
committed to providing authors with a timely and efficient review process for evaluation of their
manuscripts.

The journal publishes **original research articles, review articles, mini-reviews, short
communications, and case reports** across a wide range of scientific disciplines including
Biological Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Sciences, Nursing, Health Sciences,
Agriculture, Life Sciences, Engineering and Technology and other related fields.

The aim of WJARR is to establish a global platform for exchanging ideas and new emerging trends
within the scientific community. The journal is committed to publishing articles that strengthen the
knowledge of academicians, researchers and scientists. Each manuscript is selected for its original
contribution to scholarly research and is reviewed to ensure intellectual rigor and relevance to
academic and professional communities.

* High Impact factor Journal (Impact factor 8.2)
* Google Indexed Journal – articles indexed by Google
* Crossref Indexed Journal – DOI assignment without extra charges
* Indexed in several national and international indexing services
* Open Access Journal – authors retain copyrights
* Simple manuscript submission via email or online system
* Free certificate of publication for all authors

### How to Publish in World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews

**Authors who wish to publish research or review articles in the international journal World Journal
of Advanced Research and Reviews should submit their manuscript via email attachment to:**

**Email: **[**editor@wjarr.com**][28]

Authors familiar with online submission systems may submit their manuscript through the online
submission link available on the journal website.

Before submission, authors should ensure that the manuscript follows the **WJARR author
guidelines**. Authors are required to send a covering letter and author declaration form. All
authors should also review the journal’s publication ethics and malpractice policy.

Submitted manuscripts must not have been published or submitted elsewhere. Only original and
plagiarism-free articles will be considered. All manuscripts undergo **double blind peer review**
and final decisions are based on quality, originality and contribution to existing knowledge.

An acknowledgement of manuscript submission will be sent to the corresponding author by email.
